errors.text_span: 按字母顺序从左至右依次排列了
errors.evidence: The description claims the x-axis categories are in alphabetical order, but they are not. The order is Operation, Time, Disease, Medicine, Examination, Symptom. Alphabetical order would be Disease, Examination, Medicine, Operation, Symptom, Time.
The bar for 'Medicine' is visibly lower than the bars for 'Operation' and 'Time', which are both around 11%. Therefore, the value for 'Medicine' cannot be 12%. It is approximately 9-10%.

The bar for 'Examination' is clearly below the 20% line. The midpoint between 15% and 20% is 17.5%. The top of the bar appears to be below this midpoint. A value of 19% is a significant overestimation; the value is closer to 17%.
